subject.title: fix(scripts): bound release CI summary GitHub lookups

question: Should full release validation adopt a 60-second hard failure deadline for every release-summary GitHub lookup and artifact download?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes release validation from waiting up to the enclosing workflow budget to failing an individual slow lookup after one minute; source inspection cannot establish the release-owner latency policy.

options.title: Adopt the 60-second cap
options.body: Confirm that failing a single release-summary GitHub request after one minute is the intended release-operation policy once live evidence is attached.

options.title: Choose a different operational deadline
options.body: Keep bounded subprocess execution but set a release-owner-selected timeout that better matches expected GitHub and artifact latency.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 60-second cap
recommendation.body: Confirm that failing a single release-summary GitHub request after one minute is the intended release-operation policy once live evidence is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only directly identified person connected to the proposed timeout contract; current-main release-script ownership was not recoverable from the available read-only evidence.
